name: Zoom Sheets
desc: Builds spreadsheets from meeting data and plain-language prompts.
desc_zh: 用大白话或会议数据直接生成表格和分析
solves: Building a tracker by hand means rows, formulas and a fresh import each week. Zoom Sheets writes the formulas and pulls data in from PDFs and transcripts.
solves_zh: 手工搭表格要对齐行列、写公式，每周还要重新导一次数据。Zoom Sheets 自动写公式，并支持从 PDF 和转写稿导入数据。
best_for: A meeting produced numbers you now need as a formatted spreadsheet.
best_for_zh: 会上冒出一堆数字，你需要立刻变成一份像样的表格。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.zoom.com/en/products/whats-new/ (product timeline, June 2026), t）。 Launched with the Zoom AI Productivity Suite on 2026-06-01. The What's New timeline adds that it can import data from PDFs, meeting transcripts and Zoom Canvas. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://news.zoom.com/zoom-launches-ai-productivity-suite/
